title: Build memory search, filters and stream
head: Final receipt commit is the PR head; implementation_head identifies the initial tested code, and review_corrections.implementation_head identifies the tested fixes.
isolation: Dedicated Git worktree; owner checkout preserved. Managed creation failed from the Projects parent directory; attaching the fallback reported it was not a managed worktree.

github_recheck.base_decision: D-24 is still unmerged at its corrected head. Target its branch rather than rebasing the staged D stack onto main.
github_recheck.parent_ci: Full-suite test job is FAILURE; local D-25 checks and PR CI are separate evidence.
github_recheck.fetch: Origin refs refreshed via authenticated HTTPS after SSH fetch stalled; remote configuration unchanged.

compile_context: Uses established F01 structural types and the D-series controls/shell through D-24. No unmerged F17/F18 implementation imports; not verified as an isolated cherry-pick onto D-01.

design_reference.inspection: Native Memory canvas viewed at 48%; UI-35 handoff read at 100% in browser. No old HTML mockup substituted.
design_reference.limits: A separate Memory canvas image was not retained before browser restart. Runtime screenshots cover eight combinations; no pixel-diff or eight-native-export comparison is claimed.

host_gates: Authenticated F17/F18 reader with the same canonical vault and usage provider
Real whole-collection bounded query counts, exact filters and opaque cursor continuation
Canonical correction/deletion/provenance/usage changes and restart invalidate cursors without cached text
Refresh on reconnect/canonical changes; retain one controller per scope and retire on logout/replacement
Authorized suggestion catalogs or exact entry; never collection-wide facets inferred from one page
D-26 supplies canonical detail navigation and its own fresh permissions; no writer is implemented here

implementation: Four shared controls, stable count region, grouped dates, full readable row targets, quiet arrows and long-text wrapping
Generation and abort guards cover debounce, late success/error and pagination; filters survive refresh, failures and room remounts
Read-only HTTP port uses no-store authenticated requests; missing providers never fall back to fixture data
50-row queries retain exact counts, frozen filters and Updated bounds; malformed, unreadable or inconsistent pages fail as a whole
Stale/error clears old rows while retaining filters; access revocation/retirement clears content and filters
Canonical IDs, permissions, scope, basis, validity and evidence retained; usage qualifies selected-only, unavailable and retained supply
Isolated static preview with no daemon, user vault, API proxy or external action

commit_hooks.note: Normal license, migration, template, package, related-test and TypeScript checks. No bypass or coauthor trailer.

browser.method: CUA native Chromium browser interaction and read-only DOM geometry inspection
observed: Light/dark, expanded/rail, chat closed/open show all six fixture rows without horizontal overflow
Combined search/Source/Used in/Updated query returns two matches with identical field rectangles
Loading, no-match, empty, stale, error, unavailable and unsupported retain four controls and the result-count position
Tab focus, exact-entry Enter application and focus return, whole-row Enter canonical-ID callback
3783-character fact and long scope retain full text at all three narrow widths without horizontal overflow
Pagination shows 50, 100 and 123 rows; server-port search finds the last-page needle as one match
Settled chat close/open retains search and composer draft; narrow chat uses inherited single-panel shell
browser.console: No app-origin warnings/errors observed. Grammarly extension warnings/errors recorded separately in browser evidence.

not_run.cause: The F stack is unmerged and default-off; this task deliberately uses the structural seam without importing or activating it.

not_run.check: OS reduced-motion, screen-reader and multi-browser certification
not_run.cause: Not exercised in this Chromium fixture verification; the new stream adds no animation.
Affected Brief suite and required hooks run locally; full repository suite is delegated to PR CI.

limitations: Rapid ten-cycle chat-toggle attempt hit a locator timeout during an inherited shell transition. Settled continuity passed; interruption/ten-cycle certification is not claimed.
Preview queries the complete isolated fixture collection behind the bounded port. It is not a real vault or a production fallback.
No source-facet endpoint exists in the inspected contract; suggestions require an authorized host catalog, with exact entry available otherwise.
Controller persistence covers room remounts, not browser restarts. Host integration owns reconnect and canonical-change refresh.
Existing F07/F08 optional tests remain skipped; existing UI build at-rule warnings remain.
No D-26 detail/edit/forget implementation, deployment or release activation.
rollback: Remove optional memoryRegistrations/specimen dispatch or revert D-25 commits. Production defaults unchanged; no migration or backend writer reversal.
quick_verify: bun run build:ui && bun run scripts/preview-brief-memory.ts; open http://127.0.0.1:4415/?brief=preview&specimen=memory#/_brief_preview; search pilot with Meeting notes / Meeting follow-ups / Past 7 days for two matches; use many + needle for a match beyond page one.

fixes.result: Source exact entry preserves line-feed labels using the shared textarea; Shift+Enter inserts a line; the control remains 44px high at the default text scale.
Source and Used in ignore Enter/Escape while isComposing or keyCode 229 is set; ordinary application and cancellation retain dropdown focus.

observed: Multiline labels retained before and after apply
Shift+Enter inserts a line; Escape preserves the applied value
Desktop and 390px controls/result-count geometry unchanged; no horizontal overflow

limits: Native OS IME not exercised; composition behavior verified through React DOM keyboard regression tests.
review_corrections.activation: Unchanged: code remains unmerged, release disabled, no live F17/F18/provider effects.
